programs.description: David, a don, sends Bhai, a hitman, to Hyderabad to kill a policeman who is disrupting mafia operations. However, when Bhai learns that the officer is his own brother, he decides to protect him.
Karthika and Jeeva, two college-going students, fall in love with each other but are forced to separate by their families. However, when they try to reunite, tragedy strikes.
After leaving his life of crime behind, Aadhi is drawn back into the drug trade by his former gang leader. However, after meeting Seema and falling in love, he decides to atone for his past mistakes.
Upon learning of her father's involvement in corruption, a girl, along with her two friends, embarks on a mission to teach him a lesson.
Selvam, a criminal seeking a fresh start in Hyderabad, falls for a dancer. Just as they plan their future, unresolved events from his past resurface, threatening his new life.
Saravanan, an Indian living abroad, struggles to sell his ancestral home in India due to the supposed presence of ghosts in it. He devises a plan to prove that his house is not haunted.
A group of friends reunite for the wedding of one of their own. However, when a mishap threatens to ruin the event, only a series of cricket matches can save the day.
A man reluctantly agrees to help a medical student who is in trouble by sheltering her in his apartment. However, trouble ensues when she is found dead the next morning.

Chandran lies to his boss in order to go and watch a football match, but his boss also attends the match and catches him. Later, to save his job, Chandran is forced to lie about having a twin brother.
After narrowly escaping a serial killer who murders his girlfriend, Ashok spirals into a relentless quest for revenge, determined to uncover the identity of the mysterious murderer.

Raghu, a software engineer, faces several challenges in his arranged marriage as he suffers from erectile dysfunction and tries to find a solution to his problem.
Valarmathi, a girl from a wealthy family, falls in love with Pandi, who rents out sound systems for various occasions. When they are set to get married, an accident changes the course of their lives.
A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.
Perusu, a local gangster, is considered a messiah by the poor and underprivileged of the society. However, the police decide to catch and kill him.
Autorickshaw driver Sakthi is head-over-heels in love with his neighbour, Leena. His world spirals into chaos when three ruthless criminals threaten his life.
In Vizag and Aruku, a series of murders unfold. Meanwhile, a couple unknowingly visits Aruku during their vacation, only for the woman to mysteriously disappear.
Bringing the best in cinema.
When ill luck befalls a family, Kathiresan decides to please the gods by offering their pet rooster as a sacrifice. However, things do not go as expected as the rooster goes missing.

When terrorists hijack a plane from Chennai, a struggle with the pilots damages the engine forcing them to make an emergency landing in Tirupati. NSG commando Ravi is entrusted with rescue operations.
Wisam Ahmad Kashmiri, a RAW agent, tries to prevent a terrorist organisation from executing a deadly mission against three countries.

Four strangers come together to rob the house of a wealthy man. However, when they reach his doorstep, they are taken aback to know that the man is bankrupt.
After purchasing hair oil, an aspiring actor instead receives a firearm. However, things take a turn when he attempts to get rid of it, but becomes part of a sinister ploy.
Four students form a secret group and decide to fight against corruption in society by creating a website where the public can lodge grievances.
Shiva, a former cop, vows never to return to the force, but when his wife is brutally murdered by the notorious don P, he swears vengeance.

Five members of a Facebook movie enthusiasts group decide to meet up in an old bungalow to make a short film. However, things go haywire as the gang begins to experience paranormal activities and seek aid from a mentalist.
A man and a woman are in love with each other but on the day of their wedding, he ends up killing her. Soon, in prison, he realises the conspiracy behind the crime and plans to solve the mystery.
Jaison, a young tailor, gains superpowers after being struck by lightning. However, he must thwart the evil intentions of an unexpected adversary to become the superhero that his rural village needs.
Adi and Tara meet during a wedding ceremony and fall in love. However, they decide to start a live-in relationship as they do not believe in the institution of marriage.
A group of four friends have a tight-knit bond and follow each other everywhere. However, they escape to Chennai after murdering their village leader's son.

An accident brings Kapil and Kanchana Mala together, who then begin dating. However, their dream of getting married is interrupted due to disapproval and revenge.
Thamizh is a talented yet struggling director who strives for success. One day, he invites his close friends to work on a script that could be their first big break in the film industry.
Pandiyan, a gang member seeking reform, is framed for murder, forcing him to disguise himself as a wealthy man's missing son to evade danger.
Ambikathy, an orphan, leaves his cruel uncle and ends up at Marina Beach, where he sells food to save money for night school, determined to pursue his dream of getting an education.
A young Ram is left in a monastery by his uncle with a promise that Sita will come for him and take care of him. Years later, he is ecstatic when he meets Sita.
Four policemen lead a peaceful and ideal life in a model village. However, their world is turned upside down when they are transferred to a riot-prone village.
A man gains great notoriety in his village for his unmatched strength and brutal nature, which makes him a target of antisocial elements with a ruthless agenda.
Two unemployed brothers who do not get along well due to their contrasting natures try to marry the women they love before an accident changes their lives.
Chezhiyan, the spoilt son of a minister, commits crimes but gets away with it. However, he is soon abducted by Easan and ACP Sangayya investigates the case only to stumble upon disturbing truths.

A rising football star's world turns upside down when his mentor Benji is murdered. Caught in a web of vengeance and power struggles, he fights to reclaim his future before it is too late.
Aadhi, who suffers from night blindness, finds his carefully structured life thrown into disarray after he's mistakenly labelled as the face of a protest movement.
Raja Vikramarka leaves his lavish life to pursue freedom and find the perfect suitor. However, in the city, he becomes a bodyguard for a wealthy lady whose life is constantly put in danger.
A freak accident transports depressed Jeeva to a utopian alternate reality. He finds purpose in this ideal life, but fate intervenes, pulling him back to his original world.

Krishna, a young man from an orthodox Brahmin family, falls in love with Vrinda, a woman unable to have children. To gain his family's approval, Krishna elaborates a lie to convince them to agree to the marriage.
A thief plans the robbery of a lifetime. However, he wakes up one morning to realise that he has lost his memory and his life is at stake.
Panchamukhi, a wife and mother, leaves her family devastated when she dies according to a prophecy by Goddess Durga. However, her grieving husband encounters an exact lookalike of her in the city.
A ground-breaking scientific experiment brings a deceased man to life. However, things take a turn when he tries to escape the facility after waking up with no memories.
Nandha Gopalan Kumaran, a social worker, is forced to join politics to help his village. He faces various obstacles while learning the tricks to survive in power.

Two women, co-passengers on a plane journey, become friends and share their love stories. One of them is shocked when she learns that the man she is dating resembles her new friend's fiancé.
A case of mistaken identities causes Prem and Sanjana to fall in love. Meanwhile, Sanjana's uncles try to get the money that she has inherited and Prem convinces them to marry her off to him.
A man, who has many police officers in his family, fails to become one after he locks horns with the police commissioner's wayward son.
A man with strong traditional values falls in love with a woman, and they decide to get married, until the groom and the bride's father have a difference of opinion about marriage.
A tech-savvy person is given a task to fix the mobile connection of an entire city, unaware that the completion of it could activate a bomb explosion.
Kamalakannan, an organic farmer, marries Bharathi, a bank manager. However, his grandmother does not want his wife to work after marriage, which leads to a tussle between them.
Tied to the history of an ancient relic, Ajayan faces the consequences of his forefathers' decisions and their cascading fates.
A kind-hearted young man falls in love with a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside down after learning about his relationship with the woman from a previous birth.
Raja and Khanum's romance is short-lived as she does not return from her trip to Malaysia. Years later, she comes to India and finds Raja, but is shocked to learn about his personal life.

Nirupama hires a private investigator to keep a watch on her husband, Vishwanath. However, she is shocked to discover that there is more to him than meets the eye.
Narayana attempts to solve the mystery behind the treasure that has gone missing. However, Jayaram, a gang leader, places several obstacles in his way.
Devi, a man who cannot stay put as he is addicted to going on new adventures, breaks up with his girlfriend, Shaina, who is a Warsaw-based psychiatrist, just to pursue his daredevil ambitions.
A businesswoman adopts a stranger who saves her life and raises him as her son. However, the young man has a dark past that catches up with him despite his mother's attempts to shield him from it.
Harsha, a successful expat, is willing to marry any woman his parents choose for him. However, he eventually falls for Vibha, an outspoken lady, who challenges his views on marriage.
Kumaran and Nallavan relocate to Chennai to start a new life. Though they get employed and are successful in the beginning, eventually their past comes to haunt them.
Bharath, a surgeon working in the US, embarks on a mission to India, to find his biological parents and reconcile with them.
Raghuram, a journalist, exposes the criminal activities of an infamous gangster, who later murders him as revenge. Years later, Rajaram, Raghuram's son, decides to track down the killer.
In an attempt to give up his violent past, a man decides to change himself for the woman he loves. Soon, when his lover's family is threatened by evil forces, he takes matters into his own hands.
